Rough with small dogs, does NOT follow instructions, inappropriate/unaccountable management, will NOT report injuries.
I have been going to this location to have my small dog groomed for two years. Several times during our visits, small injuries have occurred during appointments, such as nails clipped too short, causing bleeding, blood blisters from clipping the harness on fast/roughly, and injuries from not following instructions specific to my dog's medical history. All of these times, I would not be told about these injuries but would find them shortly after arriving home with her. I understand that small dogs can be difficult to work with sometimes, and as someone who works with the general public, I also understand that customers can be difficult to work with. However, I find it very unprofessional and inappropriate to not report any injuries to the dogs' owners in these instances. Most recently, I took my dog home after what was supposed to be just a wash, cut, and nail trim, and her eye began to swell shut, and she cried late into the night from her glands being expressed, of which she had a recent injury that I informed the front desk about. After speaking with who I assume to be a supervisor I am deeply unsatisfied with how they decided to handle the situation. Throughout my entire conversation with this man, he took no accountability for anything and attempted to try and shift accountability to me for the injury my dog acquired while in their care. He took none of my concerns seriously and persistently downplayed the issues/previous injuries my dog had experienced. As a supervisor, I understand the need to defend your team. However, failing to report an injury to the client is unacceptable and does NOT build trust.
Since this conversation, I have contacted the store for a refund, but after five days, I have received no response. I would not recommend this location to anyone who cares about the safety of their dogs or has a dog with a medical history/condition.

1 Year Later ***It’s wild looking back on this now. I still can’t believe how this was handled—and how it still is. If you look at any review where someone shares a bad experience, you’ll notice the same pattern: no accountability, just excuses and blame pushed back on the customer.

And these reviews? They’re just the ones who spoke up. Who knows how many people have stayed quiet after trusting them with one of the most vulnerable members of their family and getting them back hurt and terrified.

They love to say every complaint is the customer’s fault. And honestly, in a way, they’re right—but not how they think. Because if you read all this, see how they respond, and still end up with your dog harmed, then yeah—what you did was trust the wrong people. ***
Absolutely love this Petbar location! Friendly, clean, and great with pets. The staff and owners are wonderful. Bring your pet, you won't be disappointed.

I'm actually super frustrated with the service at this location. I came in on Monday 8/26 around 5:10pm. I go to the pet store next door for my dog food and made a stop in here to wash my dog. The website says that they take the last self serve wash 30 minutes before close which would have been 5:30. The girl at the desk lied to my face and said that they stop at 5. When I questioned her about the website she said they just sent an email changing the policy which I thought was odd given that the info is still on the website. So I called a different location where surprise surprise they also confirmed the information on the website. So I'm thinking to myself ok maybe this store has a different policy. So I wait until today to call this same location and the person on the phone confirmed that the last wash is at 5:30, 30 minutes before close. I explained what happened and asked for a manager and guess what no managers work at the store and they can't give out the corporate number or email address. I'm curious what kind of liars they allow to work here and I'm so annoyed because I drove 25 minutes to get to this store. I would really like a manager who apparently doesn't exist, to follow up with me because that is horrible customer service.
